dedupe_keys.name: access to intercity air bus and rail transportation in rural areas

description: Access to Intercity Air, Bus, and Rail Transportation in Rural Areas is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Research and Statistics", published or maintained by Bureau of Transportation Statistics. Total and percent of rural population with access to scheduled intercity bus, rail, and air transportation. Rural areas are Census block groups with their centroid (center) outside of all Census urban areas. Summarized to county level. Facilities used available at: Interactive map showing access to intercity transportation in rural areas: Methodology:. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Research and Statistics". It has 144 columns, among them P65AIRCT, LF_AIRL, V0, V0_RAIL, BIN_L25K, ALL_18C. The portal shows 2023-09-25 as the last data update. Attribution given: Bureau of Transportation Statistics. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
